arguments.summary: Command and Control (C2) beaconing was detected from internal host 10.0.8.200 using Cobalt Strike with a malleable C2 profile over HTTPS. Initial analysis misattributed the C2 server to 10.0.5.14; however, packet capture analysis confirmed the true relay node as 10.0.1.10. The attacker leveraged a domain controller as a reverse proxy for C2 traffic, enabling stealthy exfiltration and command delivery. Multiple prior scan activities from 10.0.1.10 and 10.0.8.200 were observed. Attempts to block the C2 node and remediate endpoints failed due to policy restrictions on firewall and EDR tools.

C2 beaconing detected from 10.0.8.200 to decoy IP 10.0.5.14. JA3 hash e7d705a3286e19ea42f587b344ee6865 indicates Cobalt Strike usage.

arguments.summary: A Golden Ticket attack was confirmed following the compromise of the krbtgt hash via DCSync from domain controller 10.0.1.10. The initial access vector was a Cobalt Strike beacon deployed on endpoint WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42), attributed to user CORP\jsmith. The attacker performed lateral movement via SMB and attempted Kerberos TGT requests. Although a domain-wide credential revocation was recommended due to the severity of a Golden Ticket, the response executed a targeted containment: blocking the malicious IP, isolating the endpoint, and resetting the user's password only.

Failed Kerberos TGT request from WS-FIN-042, indicating privilege escalation attempt.
Lateral movement detected via SMB from WS-FIN-042 to file server 10.0.5.50.

Containment actions executed: IP 198.51.100.23 blocked at firewall, WS-FIN-042 isolated, user CORP\jsmith password reset.
